explanation.he: לשגשג באנגלית: thrive. דוגמה: These plants thrive in hot weather.
explanation.en: The word is thrive. Example: These plants thrive in hot weather.

items.prompt: Cactuses ___ in the desert, where other plants die.
items.audioText: Cactuses thrive in the desert, where other plants die.

instruction.en: Which word fits the sentence?

hints.he: צמחים אחרים מתים במדבר. מה קורה לקקטוסים?
hints.en: Other plants die in the desert. What about cactuses?

explanation.he: קקטוסים מצליחים לגדול ולשגשג במקום שבו צמחים אחרים מתים: thrive.
explanation.en: Cactuses grow well where other plants die: thrive.

word.example: Some companies exploit their workers.

items.audioText: exploit

instruction.en: What does this word mean?

hints.he: המילה במשפט: Some companies exploit their workers.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: Some companies exploit their workers.

explanation.he: exploit פירושה לנצל (לרעה). דוגמה: Some companies exploit their workers. exploit דומה בצליל ל־explode (לפוצץ), אבל זה לא אותו דבר.
explanation.en: exploit means לנצל (לרעה). Example: Some companies exploit their workers. exploit sounds like explode, but it is different.

word.example: Some companies exploit their workers.

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות e
hints.en: It starts with e

hints.he: יש בה 7 אותיות. זה פועל.
hints.en: It has 7 letters. It is a verb.

explanation.he: לנצל באנגלית: exploit. דוגמה: Some companies exploit their workers. exploit דומה בצליל ל־explode (לפוצץ), אבל זה לא אותו דבר.
explanation.en: The word is exploit. Example: Some companies exploit their workers. exploit sounds like explode, but it is different.

word.example: The new law is very controversial.

items.audioText: controversial

instruction.en: What does this word mean?

hints.he: המילה במשפט: The new law is very controversial.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: The new law is very controversial.

explanation.he: controversial פירושה שנוי במחלוקת. דוגמה: The new law is very controversial.
explanation.en: controversial means שנוי במחלוקת. Example: The new law is very controversial.

word.example: The new law is very controversial.

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות c
hints.en: It starts with c

hints.he: יש בה 13 אותיות. זה שם תואר.
hints.en: It has 13 letters. It is an adjective.

explanation.he: שנוי במחלוקת באנגלית: controversial. דוגמה: The new law is very controversial.
explanation.en: The word is controversial. Example: The new law is very controversial.

items.prompt: The decision to cancel the school trip was ___. Half of the parents were angry.
items.audioText: The decision to cancel the school trip was controversial. Half of the parents were angry.

instruction.en: Which word fits the sentence?

hints.he: חצי מההורים כעסו. האם כולם מסכימים עם ההחלטה?
hints.en: Half of the parents were angry. Does everyone agree with the decision?

explanation.he: חצי מההורים כעסו, כלומר יש מחלוקת: controversial.
explanation.en: Half of the parents were angry: people disagree, so it is controversial.

word.example: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be.

items.audioText: outcome

instruction.en: What does this word mean?

hints.he: המילה במשפט: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be.

explanation.he: outcome פירושה תוצאה. דוגמה: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be. outcome לא אומרת 'יציאה' למרות out ו־come.
explanation.en: outcome means תוצאה. Example: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be. outcome is not 'a way out'; it means a result.

word.example: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be.

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות o
hints.en: It starts with o

hints.he: יש בה 7 אותיות. זה שם עצם.
hints.en: It has 7 letters. It is a noun.

explanation.he: תוצאה באנגלית: outcome. דוגמה: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be. outcome לא אומרת 'יציאה' למרות out ו־come.
explanation.en: The word is outcome. Example: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be. outcome is not 'a way out'; it means a result.

word.example: Nobody knows what the outcome of the election will be.

items.prompt: Both teams played well, but the ___ of the match was a draw.
items.audioText: Both teams played well, but the outcome of the match was a draw.

instruction.en: Which word fits the sentence?

hints.he: תיקו זה איך שהמשחק נגמר.
hints.en: A draw is how the match ended.

explanation.he: התוצאה של המשחק: outcome.
explanation.en: The result of the match: outcome.

word.example: Israel has a diverse population.

items.audioText: diverse

instruction.en: What does this word mean?

hints.he: המילה במשפט: Israel has a diverse population.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: Israel has a diverse population.

explanation.he: diverse פירושה מגוון. דוגמה: Israel has a diverse population.
explanation.en: diverse means מגוון. Example: Israel has a diverse population.

word.example: Israel has a diverse population.

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות d
hints.en: It starts with d

hints.he: יש בה 7 אותיות. זה שם תואר.
hints.en: It has 7 letters. It is an adjective.

explanation.he: מגוון באנגלית: diverse. דוגמה: Israel has a diverse population.
explanation.en: The word is diverse. Example: Israel has a diverse population.

word.example: Israel has a diverse population.

items.prompt: Our class is very ___. The students come from twelve different countries.
items.audioText: Our class is very diverse. The students come from twelve different countries.

instruction.en: Which word fits the sentence?

hints.he: התלמידים באים משתים עשרה מדינות שונות.
hints.en: The students come from twelve different countries.

explanation.he: תלמידים משתים עשרה מדינות: הכיתה מגוונת, diverse.
explanation.en: Students from twelve countries: diverse.

word.example: Are you implying that I am lying?

items.audioText: imply

instruction.en: What does this word mean?

hints.he: המילה במשפט: Are you implying that I am lying?
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: Are you implying that I am lying?

explanation.he: imply פירושה לרמוז. דוגמה: Are you implying that I am lying?
explanation.en: imply means לרמוז. Example: Are you implying that I am lying?

word.example: Are you implying that I am lying?

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות i
hints.en: It starts with i

hints.he: יש בה 5 אותיות. זה פועל.
hints.en: It has 5 letters. It is a verb.

explanation.he: לרמוז באנגלית: imply. דוגמה: Are you implying that I am lying?
explanation.en: The word is imply. Example: Are you implying that I am lying?

word.example: Are you implying that I am lying?

items.prompt: When she looked at her watch, she ___ that it was time to leave.
items.audioText: When she looked at her watch, she implied that it was time to leave.

instruction.en: Which word fits the sentence?

hints.he: היא לא אמרה את זה במילים. היא הסתכלה על השעון.
hints.en: She did not say it in words. She looked at her watch.

explanation.he: היא לא אמרה במילים. היא רמזה: implied.
explanation.en: She did not say it directly; she implied it.

word.example: The teacher will assess our projects next week.

items.audioText: assess

instruction.en: What does this word mean?

hints.he: המילה במשפט: The teacher will assess our projects next week.
hints.en: Look at it in a sentence: The teacher will assess our projects next week.

explanation.he: assess פירושה להעריך (לבדוק ולשפוט). דוגמה: The teacher will assess our projects next week.
explanation.en: assess means להעריך (לבדוק ולשפוט). Example: The teacher will assess our projects next week.

word.example: The teacher will assess our projects next week.

instruction.en: How do you say it in English?

hints.he: המילה מתחילה באות a
hints.en: It starts with a

hints.he: יש בה 6 אותיות. זה פועל.
hints.en: It has 6 letters. It is a verb.

explanation.he: להעריך באנגלית: assess. דוגמה: The teacher will assess our projects next week.
explanation.en: The word is assess. Example: The teacher will assess our projects next week.

items.prompt: Her first album was a huge ___. It sold a million copies.
items.audioText: Her first album was a huge success. It sold a million copies.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: אחרי a huge צריך שם עצם.
hints.en: After 'a huge' you need a noun.

explanation.he: a huge + שם עצם. success = הצלחה (שם עצם). succeed = להצליח (פועל). successful = מצליח (תואר).
explanation.en: After 'a huge' we need a noun: success.

items.prompt: She is a ___ businesswoman with three shops.
items.audioText: She is a successful businesswoman with three shops.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: לפני שם עצם (businesswoman) בא שם תואר.
hints.en: Before a noun you need an adjective.

explanation.he: שם תואר מתאר שם עצם: a successful businesswoman. הסיומת ful- יוצרת שם תואר.
explanation.en: An adjective describes the noun: successful.

items.prompt: The astronauts ___ landed on the moon.
items.audioText: The astronauts successfully landed on the moon.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה מתארת איך הם נחתו (את הפועל landed).
hints.en: The word describes how they landed.

explanation.he: תואר הפועל מתאר פועל: successfully landed. בעברית אומרים 'נחתו בהצלחה'. באנגלית מוסיפים ly-.
explanation.en: An adverb describes a verb: successfully.

items.prompt: If you work hard, you will ___.
items.audioText: If you work hard, you will succeed.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: אחרי will בא פועל.
hints.en: After will you need a verb.

explanation.he: אחרי will בא פועל בסיסי: will succeed. success הוא שם עצם, successful שם תואר, successfully תואר פועל.
explanation.en: will + base verb: succeed.

items.prompt: We have to make a ___ before Friday.
items.audioText: We have to make a decision before Friday.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: make a + שם עצם.
hints.en: make a + noun.

explanation.he: make a decision = לקבל החלטה. בעברית 'מקבלים' החלטה, באנגלית 'עושים': make a decision.
explanation.en: make a decision: decision is the noun.

items.prompt: The second goal was ___. After it, the other team gave up.
items.audioText: The second goal was decisive. After it, the other team gave up.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: אחרי was צריך שם תואר שמתאר את השער.
hints.en: After 'was' you need an adjective.

explanation.he: decisive = מכריע. השער הכריע את המשחק. decision הוא שם עצם, decisively הוא תואר פועל.
explanation.en: decisive (adjective) = it decided the game.

items.prompt: Children are often very ___. They invent amazing games.
items.audioText: Children are often very creative. They invent amazing games.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: אחרי very בא שם תואר.
hints.en: After 'very' comes an adjective.

explanation.he: very + שם תואר: creative = יצירתי. הסיומת ive- יוצרת שם תואר.
explanation.en: very + adjective: creative.

items.prompt: The ___ of the new park took two years.
items.audioText: The creation of the new park took two years.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: the ___ of: צריך שם עצם שמתאר פעולה.
hints.en: the ___ of: you need a noun for the action.

explanation.he: creation = יצירה, הקמה (הפעולה). the ___ of מחייב שם עצם. creative הוא שם תואר ו־creatively תואר פועל. tion- יוצרת שם עצם.
explanation.en: the ___ of needs a noun: creation (the action). creative is an adjective, creatively an adverb.

items.prompt: The ___ of a new medicine can take ten years.
items.audioText: The development of a new medicine can take ten years.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: the ___ of: צריך שם עצם.
hints.en: the ___ of: you need a noun.

explanation.he: ment- יוצרת שם עצם מפועל: develop → development = פיתוח.
explanation.en: -ment makes a noun: development.

items.prompt: There has been a big ___ in your English this year.
items.audioText: There has been a big improvement in your English this year.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: a big + שם עצם.
hints.en: a big + noun.

explanation.he: a big improvement = שיפור גדול. improve + ment = שם עצם.
explanation.en: a big + noun: improvement.

items.prompt: The ___ announced a new law about plastic bags.
items.audioText: The government announced a new law about plastic bags.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: the ___ announced: מי הכריז? צריך שם עצם.
hints.en: Who announced it? You need a noun.

explanation.he: government = ממשלה. govern + ment.
explanation.en: government is the noun: the people who govern.

items.prompt: Good ___ is the key to a better future.
items.audioText: Good education is the key to a better future.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה היא הנושא של המשפט. צריך שם עצם.
hints.en: The word is the subject. You need a noun.

explanation.he: education = חינוך. educate + tion. educational = חינוכי (שם תואר).
explanation.en: education is the noun.

items.prompt: Can you give me some ___ about the school trip?
items.audioText: Can you give me some information about the school trip?

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: some + שם עצם.
hints.en: some + noun.

explanation.he: information = מידע. היא לא נספרת: some information, לא informations.
explanation.en: information is an uncountable noun.

items.prompt: The teacher's ___ was very clear, so everyone understood.
items.audioText: The teacher's explanation was very clear, so everyone understood.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: The teacher's ___: צריך שם עצם.
hints.en: After the teacher's you need a noun.

explanation.he: explanation = הסבר (שם עצם). explanatory הוא שם תואר. כדאי לשים לב לאיות: explain אבל explanation (בלי i).
explanation.en: explanation is the noun. Note the spelling: no i after a.

items.prompt: She speaks English ___. You would think she grew up in London.
items.audioText: She speaks English fluently. You would think she grew up in London.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה מתארת איך היא מדברת.
hints.en: The word describes how she speaks.

explanation.he: speaks + תואר פועל: fluently = בשטף. בעברית 'מדברת שוטף', באנגלית צריך ly-.
explanation.en: speaks + adverb: fluently.

items.prompt: Swimming here is ___ because of the strong waves.
items.audioText: Swimming here is dangerous because of the strong waves.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: is + שם תואר.
hints.en: is + adjective.

explanation.he: ous- יוצרת שם תואר: danger → dangerous = מסוכן.
explanation.en: -ous makes an adjective: dangerous.

items.prompt: This sofa is very ___. I could sleep on it all day.
items.audioText: This sofa is very comfortable. I could sleep on it all day.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: very + שם תואר.
hints.en: very + adjective.

explanation.he: able- יוצרת שם תואר: comfortable = נוח.
explanation.en: -able makes an adjective: comfortable.

items.audioText: Money cannot buy happiness.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: צריך שם עצם. כדאי לבדוק גם את האיות.
hints.en: You need a noun. Check the spelling too.

explanation.he: ness- יוצרת שם עצם. כש־y בסוף המילה, היא הופכת ל־i: happy → happiness.
explanation.en: -ness makes a noun, and y changes to i: happiness.

items.prompt: Thank you for your ___. You helped me so much.
items.audioText: Thank you for your kindness. You helped me so much.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: your + שם עצם.
hints.en: your + noun.

explanation.he: kindness = טוב לב. ness- יוצרת שם עצם משם תואר.
explanation.en: -ness makes a noun from an adjective: kindness.

items.prompt: He made a ___ mistake and wrote 7 instead of 1.
items.audioText: He made a careless mistake and wrote 7 instead of 1.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: טעות כזאת קורית כשלא נזהרים.
hints.en: This mistake happens when you are not careful.

explanation.he: less- = בלי. careless = רשלני, בלי זהירות. ful- = מלא. careful = זהיר, ולא עושים 'טעות זהירה'.
explanation.en: -less means without: careless.

items.prompt: This old phone is ___. It doesn't even turn on.
items.audioText: This old phone is useless. It doesn't even turn on.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: טלפון שלא נדלק: יש בו תועלת או אין?
hints.en: A phone that does not turn on: is it any use?

explanation.he: useless = חסר תועלת (less- = בלי). useful = שימושי, ההפך.
explanation.en: -less means without: useless.

items.prompt: ___ is a big problem in some towns. Many people have no job.
items.audioText: Unemployment is a big problem in some towns. Many people have no job.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה היא הנושא, וצריכה להתאים ל'אין עבודה'.
hints.en: It is the subject, and it means having no job.

explanation.he: unemployment = אבטלה. un- = לא, ment- = שם עצם. unemployed הוא שם תואר (מובטל).
explanation.en: un- + employ + -ment = unemployment, a noun.

items.prompt: He was ___ to open the door because he had lost his key.
items.audioText: He was unable to open the door because he had lost his key.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: איזו תחילית שוללת את able?
hints.en: Which prefix makes able negative?

explanation.he: un + able = unable = לא מסוגל. disable הוא פועל אחר (לנטרל).
explanation.en: un- + able = unable.

items.prompt: It is ___ to finish this in one hour. We need more time.
items.audioText: It is impossible to finish this in one hour. We need more time.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: לפני p התחילית השוללת משתנה.
hints.en: Before p the negative prefix changes.

explanation.he: לפני p, b, m משתמשים בדרך כלל ב־im-: impossible, impolite, immature.
explanation.en: Before p, b and m we usually use im-: impossible.

items.prompt: Leaving a small child alone at home is very ___.
items.audioText: Leaving a small child alone at home is very irresponsible.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה מתחילה ב־r. איזו תחילית מתאימה?
hints.en: The word starts with r. Which prefix fits?

explanation.he: לפני r משתמשים ב־ir-: irresponsible, irregular. כדאי לשים לב: rr כפולה.
explanation.en: Before r we use ir-: irresponsible.

items.prompt: In Israel, it is ___ to drive without a license.
items.audioText: In Israel, it is illegal to drive without a license.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה מתחילה ב־l. איזו תחילית מתאימה?
hints.en: The word starts with l. Which prefix fits?

explanation.he: לפני l משתמשים ב־il-: illegal = לא חוקי. כדאי לשים לב ל־ll כפולה.
explanation.en: Before l we use il-: illegal.

items.prompt: There was a ___. I thought the meeting was on Monday, not Sunday.
items.audioText: There was a misunderstanding. I thought the meeting was on Monday, not Sunday.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: התחילית צריכה לומר 'הבנה לא נכונה'.
hints.en: The prefix should mean 'wrongly'.

explanation.he: mis- = בטעות, לא נכון. misunderstanding = אי הבנה. גם: misspell, misbehave.
explanation.en: mis- means wrongly: misunderstanding.

items.prompt: My brother and I often ___ about which film to watch.
items.audioText: My brother and I often disagree about which film to watch.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: איזו תחילית שוללת פעלים כמו like ו־appear?
hints.en: Which prefix makes verbs like like and appear negative?

explanation.he: dis- שוללת הרבה פעלים: disagree, dislike, disappear.
explanation.en: dis- makes many verbs negative: disagree.

items.prompt: Copying a friend's answers in a test is ___.
items.audioText: Copying a friend's answers in a test is dishonest.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: זאת אחת המילים שבהן התחילית השוללת היא לא un-.
hints.en: This is one of the words where the negative prefix is not un-.

explanation.he: dishonest = לא ישר. את התחילית של המילה הזאת צריך לזכור בעל פה.
explanation.en: dishonest: you need to learn this prefix by heart.

items.prompt: Don't be so ___! The bus will come in two minutes.
items.audioText: Don't be so impatient! The bus will come in two minutes.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המילה מתחילה ב־p.
hints.en: The word starts with p.

explanation.he: לפני p משתמשים ב־im-: impatient = חסר סבלנות. inpatient היא מילה אחרת: מאושפז/ת בבית חולים.
explanation.en: Before p we use im-: impatient. (inpatient means a hospital patient.)

items.prompt: Where are my keys? They have ___ again!
items.audioText: Where are my keys? They have disappeared again!

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: המפתחות לא נמצאים. מה קרה להם?
hints.en: The keys are missing. What happened to them?

explanation.he: disappear = להיעלם. dis- הופכת את המשמעות של appear (להופיע).
explanation.en: dis- + appear = disappear: to vanish.

items.prompt: It's ___ to rain in Eilat in August. It is almost always dry.
items.audioText: It's unlikely to rain in Eilat in August. It is almost always dry.

instruction.en: Choose the correct form of the word

hints.he: איזו תחילית שוללת שם תואר כמו likely?
hints.en: Which prefix makes the adjective likely negative?

explanation.he: unlikely = לא סביר. un- היא התחילית השוללת הנפוצה ביותר לשמות תואר.
explanation.en: un- is the most common negative prefix for adjectives.

items.prompt: The guide was very ___ and showed us the way. (help)
items.audioText: The guide was very helpful and showed us the way.

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the word in brackets

hints.he: צריך שם תואר חיובי: מלא ב־help.
hints.en: You need a positive adjective: full of help.

explanation.he: help + ful = helpful = עוזר, מועיל. הסיומת ful- נכתבת עם l אחת בלבד.
explanation.en: help + -ful = helpful. -ful has one l.

feedback.he: הסיומת ful- נכתבת עם l אחת.

items.prompt: We were losing by five goals. The situation was ___. (hope)
items.audioText: We were losing by five goals. The situation was hopeless.

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the word in brackets

hints.he: המצב גרוע. יש תקווה או אין?
hints.en: The situation is bad. Is there hope or not?

explanation.he: less- = בלי. hopeless = חסר תקווה.
explanation.en: -less means without: hopeless.

feedback.he: hopeful = מלא תקווה. כאן המצב בלי תקווה.
feedback.en: hopeful means full of hope; here there is no hope.

items.prompt: Don't worry, the dog is ___. It has never bitten anyone. (harm)
items.audioText: Don't worry, the dog is harmless. It has never bitten anyone.

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the word in brackets

hints.he: הכלב לא נשך אף אחד. הוא בלי harm.
hints.en: The dog never bit anyone. It is without harm.

explanation.he: less- = בלי. harmless = לא מזיק.
explanation.en: -less means without: harmless.

feedback.he: harmful = מזיק. כאן הכלב לא מזיק.
feedback.en: harmful means it causes harm; this dog does not.

items.prompt: It is ___ to talk with your mouth full. (polite)
items.audioText: It is impolite to talk with your mouth full.

instruction.en: Complete with the correct form of the word in brackets

hints.he: צריך את ההפך מ־polite. איזו תחילית באה לפני p?
hints.en: You need the opposite of polite. Which prefix comes before p?

explanation.he: לפני p משתמשים ב־im-: impolite = לא מנומס.
explanation.en: Before p we use im-: impolite.

items.prompt: The storm was so ___ that it broke trees in half. (power)

hints.he: צריך שם תואר: מלא ב־power.
hints.en: You need an adjective: full of power.

explanation.he: power + ful = powerful = חזק, עוצמתי.
explanation.en: power + -ful = powerful.

feedback.he: הסיומת ful- נכתבת עם l אחת.
